prompts.name: kk_trainer_sms_phone
prompts.prompt: Image 1 is an iPhone Messages (SMS) screenshot in dark mode. Create a realistic amateur photo, taken with a second phone, of a person's left hand holding a black iPhone upright that displays exactly image 1 on its screen, in the casual style of image 2. Show the phone from the top of the screen down to just below the last gray message bubble; the bottom of the phone may be cut off by the frame. Slightly tilted, slightly from above. Background: dim bedroom, blurry, warm lamp light. The screen content must be identical to image 1: black background, green bubbles on the right, dark gray bubbles on the left, the gym door photo, the same Korean text and line breaks, the same header with the contact name. Do not add, remove or repeat any message. Add subtle real-photo artifacts: slight moire on the screen, faint glare, a few fingerprint smudges, phone camera noise. No other text, no watermark.
